notes.title: In the platformer-metroidvania Soulchild you're a demon trying to get back home
notes.notes:
It's not easy being a demon it seems, especially when you're somewhat lost and trying to get home. Soulchild follows the story of Silk, who was kicked out of Hell by a new king.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/07/in-the-platformer-metroidvania-soulchild-youre-a-demon-trying-to-get-back-home
